dialogues.speaker: The Steambird Culture and Arts Section
dialogues.text: "Radiant and Rejuvenated: Quality Water Gives You a Quality Appearance"

dialogues.speaker: The Steambird Culture and Arts Section
dialogues.text: Has everyone drunk enough water today? The human body can't live without water, and your skin is a part of your body, so the importance of staying moisturized cannot be overstated!

dialogues.speaker: The Steambird Culture and Arts Section
dialogues.text: According to the wisdom of Monsieur Neuvillette, the taste, texture, and temperature of water is different in every place...

dialogues.speaker: The Steambird Culture and Arts Section
dialogues.text: I have absolute faith in the authority of his statements, and if he says it, there must be some truth behind it. Thus, I have begun to research the skincare effectiveness of water from different locations.

dialogues.speaker: The Steambird Culture and Arts Section
dialogues.text: After bathing in water from different locations across Fontaine, I am ready to share my conclusions with everyone—

dialogues.speaker: The Steambird Culture and Arts Section
dialogues.text: As for me, I highly recommend the water surrounding Merusea Village. After bathing in water from there, my skin was soft and silky, and I felt calm and relaxed...

dialogues.speaker: The Steambird Culture and Arts Section
dialogues.text: After all, it is the home of the Melusines, and everywhere there smells like happiness, and like home.
